lines.6: 「I want to wash your back for you.」
lines.9: 「I just want to do something nice for my big sis.」
lines.10: 「You... you sure know how to be cute.」
lines.13: 「Fine. I'll put on a swimsuit too, so wait in the room.」
lines.16: 「But I'm the one who's supposed to wash your back.」
lines.19: 「Of course not! And don't say 'wry laugh' out loud!」
lines.20: SMACK! She slapped me across the back with her palm.
lines.23: Scrub, scrub. Otome washed my back.
lines.25: 「Having a lovely young maiden wash your back... Of course you're happy.」
lines.26: 「No, I'm happy because it's you, Otome.」
lines.27: 「You know, those little things you do and say can be awfully cute.」
lines.28: She started washing a little more gently.
lines.29: 「I want you to wash the front too.」
lines.32: 「This is what I get for spoiling you even a little.」
lines.33: 「Ow, Big Sis, that's a little rough.」
lines.37: Nice. This was starting to feel like a devoted wife tending to her husband.
lines.38: I had to keep this up.
